The '''abandoned tapcaf''' was a [[Tapcafe/Legends|tapcafe]] establishment that had been ruined by a [[Fire/Legends|fire]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="MK">''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]''</ref> In [[44 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> [[Wraith Squadron]] re-appropriated it for use as a safe house under the guise of renovating the facility for very undervalued rates. They did some restoration on the building.<ref name="MK" />
